description:
Role: Full Stack Developer
Mandatory Skills
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern web development concepts
 - Hands-on experience with frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js
 - Strong experience in developing responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
 - Experience in building reusable UI components and implementing responsive, mobile-first designs
 - Hands-on experience with backend development using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, .NET, or similar technologies
 - Strong experience in designing, developing, and optimizing RESTful APIs and microservices
 - Experience integrating frontend applications with backend services and external APIs
 - Knowledge of database design, querying, and performance optimization for SQL and NoSQL databases (including MongoDB)
 - Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth2, JWT, and SSO
 - Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows
 - Understanding of software design principles, object-oriented programming, and application architecture patterns
 - Experience with testing frameworks and debugging techniques across frontend and backend applications
 Desirable Skills
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
 - Experience with state management frameworks such as Redux, NgRx, or Vuex
 - Knowledge of server-side rendering (SSR) and frontend performance optimization techniques
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
 - Familiarity with Apache Camel and enterprise integration patterns
 - Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) standards and UI/UX best practices
 - Exposure to automated testing tools such as Jest, Cypress, Selenium, JUnit, or Playwright
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills
